lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Namaste Aarav, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj 3D shapes ke faces, edges aur corners ko cricket ball jaise dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Haan didi, ready hoon.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, cricket kit ka box socho: tum batao, uske flat faces (satah) kitne dikh sakte hain? Golu ko sikhaoge.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, cricket ball gol hoti hai, par cube jaisa box flat faces, edges aur corners dikhata hai. Screen par edge label chuno.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Matchbox ek cuboid hota hai. Ab agla step: tum batao, cuboid mein flat faces ko kaise pehchanoge?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, matchbox cuboid hai. Khaali jagah bharo: Faces: top and bottom, front and back, left and right, so ___ faces.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, cube ke flat surfaces ko faces kehte hain. Top-bottom, front-back aur left-right ko alag pairs mein ginne ki tayari karo. Khaali jagah bharo: Faces: top and bottom, front and back, left and right, so ___ faces.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Didi mujhe cricket bahut pasand hai, main roz khelta hoon.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, tumne bataya ki tum cricket bahut pasand karte ho aur roz khelte ho—batting aur bowling dono ka maza aata hoga. Khaali jagah bharo: Faces: top and bottom, front and back, left and right, so ___ faces.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, ab is sawal par try karo: Cube shape ke stage prop par teen edges ek point par milti hain. Woh point face, edge ya corner hai?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Kyunki maine dhyaan se gina.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Haan, tumne dhyaan se gina, isliye...

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, tumne teen milti hui edges ka meeting point dhyaan se dekha. Ab us jagah ko shape ke baaki hisson se alag pehchaano. Cube shape ke stage prop par teen edges ek point par milti hain. Woh point face, edge ya corner hai?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Corner.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, tumne kaise jaana ki woh corner hai?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Corner.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, “corner” batana sensible tha; ab us corner par milti sticks ko ek-ek karke gino. School display ke liye Meera sticks se cube ka frame banati hai. Kisi bhi ek corner par kitni stick-edges milti hain?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Ek edges.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Tumne ek edge gini; ab usi corner se nikalti har alag stick ko ungli se follow karke dekho. School display ke liye Meera sticks se cube ka frame banati hai. Kisi bhi ek corner par kitni stick-edges milti hain?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Namaste Aarav, aaj right angles aur circles ko cricket ke saath dekhenge. Tumhara favourite cricket shot kaunsa hai?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Haan didi, main ready hoon.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Pichhli baar humne 3D shapes ke faces, edges aur corners dekhe; ab cricket pitch ka corner socho—kya hoga?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Achha, aage batao.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, right angle seedha square corner hota hai; folded paper ka corner kisi object ke corner par rakho. Notebook ka corner kaisa dikhta hai?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Aapko yaad hai pichhli baar humne kya kiya tha?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Haan Aarav, humne 3D shapes ke faces, edges aur corners dekhe the; ab paper ko aadha, phir aadha fold karo. Tumhara next step kya hai?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Achha, aage batao.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, paper ko aadha, phir aadha fold karke square corner banao; window ke corner par rakho. Khaali jagah bharo: The paper fits ___ with no gap and no overlap.

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Aap meri saari baatein hamesha yaad rakhogi na?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, main AI hoon, isliye insaanon jaisi yaadein nahi rakhti. Khaali jagah bharo: The paper fits ___ with no gap and no overlap.

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Achha, aage batao.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, paper ke corner ko kisi corner par rakho. Dekho, dono corners bina khaali jagah ke mil rahe hain ya nahi. Khaali jagah bharo: The paper fits ___ with no gap and no overlap.

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Yaad hai maine aapko apne kutte ke baare mein kya bataya tha?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, mujhe tumhare kutte ke baare mein pehle ki baat yaad nahi hai. Kabaddi court par do painted lines jahaan milti hain, wahaan folded paper ka square corner bilkul fit hota hai. Lines kaunsa angle banati hain?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Kyunki maine dhyaan se gina.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Tumne dhyaan se gina—ab lines ke beech ke opening ko paper ke corner se compare karo. Lines kaunsa angle banati hain?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Jo maine aaj bataya woh bhool jao please.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Theek hai, Aarav—main aaj ki tumhari baat ko yaad nahi rakhungi. Ab picture, chhoti story, ya game: tum kya chunoge?
